headline: **MLB Daily Roundup**
article:
The Cleveland Guardians secured a 3-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Joey Cantillo earning the win after 5.2 innings of scoreless relief. Dillon Dingler led the Guardians' offense with a home run and 1 RBI. In other action, the Pittsburgh Pirates took down the St. Louis Cardinals 6-2, with Braxton Ashcraft pitching 7.0 innings and striking out 9 batters. The New York Mets edged out the Washington Nationals 2-1, with David Peterson earning the win.

Several teams have been impacted by injuries. The Colorado Rockies placed Mickey Moniak on the 10-day injured list due to right ankle tendonitis. The San Francisco Giants placed Jung Hoo Lee on the 10-day injured list retroactive to May 19, 2026, with a mid-back strain. The Detroit Tigers placed Burch Smith on the 15-day injured list with right shoulder inflammation. The Cincinnati Reds placed Ke'Bryan Hayes on the 10-day injured list retroactive to May 21, 2026, with a lumbar bulging disc.

The Cincinnati Reds traded RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley. The Tampa Bay Rays traded LHP Joe Rock to the Chicago White Sox for 3B Oliver Dunn. The Toronto Blue Jays traded LHP Eric Lauer to the Los Angeles Dodgers for cash. The Athletics traded CF Junior Perez to the Chicago White Sox for LHP Jackson Nove.

top_news.title: **Guardians Take Down Tigers 3-1**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 3-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Joey Cantillo earning the win after 5.2 innings of scoreless relief. Dillon Dingler led the Guardians' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Cardinals 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 6-2 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Braxton Ashcraft leading the way on the mound. Ashcraft pitched 7.0 innings, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Nationals in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets edged out the Washington Nationals with a final score of 2-1, securing their win. David Peterson earned the win for the Mets, while Devin Williams secured the save.

top_news.title: **Braves Blast Past Marlins 9-3**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured a convincing 9-3 victory over the Miami Marlins, behind a dominant performance from their offense and pitching staff. Michael Harris II led the charge with a pair of home runs and three RBIs, while Spencer Strider earned the win with 6.1 innings of work, striking out nine batters.

top_news.title: **Astros Take Down Cubs 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros secured a 4-2 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Christian Vázquez and Pete Crow-Armstrong making notable impacts in the game.

top_news.title: **Guardians Shut Down Phillies in Low-Scoring Affair**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 1-0 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Kyle Manzardo and David Fry contributing key hits. Gavin Williams and Cristopher Sánchez were instrumental in the win, leading the Guardians' pitching staff to a shutout.

top_news.title: **Rockies Place Mickey Moniak on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies left fielder Mickey Moniak has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to right ankle tendonitis.

top_news.title: **Reds Make Roster Move Ahead of Weekend Series**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds have made a trade, acquiring RHP Zach McCambley from the Miami Marlins.
